episode.title: Bound inline diff previews while preserving complete review views
episode.before: At parent commit 694edc23b22b4696400dc47663ecacd437623870, PatchHistoryCell::display_lines rendered create_diff_summary directly. That renderer processed every changed file's complete add, delete, or update content, including wrapping and syntax highlighting, so large or minified diffs could require work proportional to the full diff. The same summary renderer also supplied raw output, and there was no separate bounded inline-preview contract or omission notice.
episode.after: At a847c71a159cfa55509fbac1619c9c2294ed4718, inline patch cells use a dedicated preview renderer with one shared budget of 12 rendered content rows across all files. Source-prefix scanning is additionally capped at 64 KiB, final wrapping is measured with the viewport renderer, file summaries remain visible, and omitted content produces a transcript-navigation notice. Transcript and raw views continue to use the unbounded full-summary path.
episode.diff: The change parameterized diff rendering with a remaining-row budget and an omission result; introduced UTF-8-safe, display-width-aware source-prefix selection plus renderer-based partial-line extraction; added create_diff_preview while retaining create_diff_summary as unbounded; routed PatchHistoryCell display output to the preview and transcript output to the full renderer; and added tests covering minified, added, deleted, updated, renamed, multi-file, narrow-width, wide-character, combining-character, exact-budget, and full-view-preservation cases.

evidence_units.claim: Commit a847c71a159cfa55509fbac1619c9c2294ed4718 is the implementation-bearing resolution for PR/issue 41143, with parent 694edc23b22b4696400dc47663ecacd437623870 and four changed TUI files.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json resolved_commit, parent_commit, linked_pull_requests, and commit_show_stat; git show --stat a847c71a159cfa55509fbac1619c9c2294ed4718

evidence_units.claim: Before the change, PatchHistoryCell::display_lines called create_diff_summary, and raw_lines called the same renderer at RAW_DIFF_SUMMARY_WIDTH; no dedicated transcript override or bounded preview renderer existed.
The renderer gained create_diff_preview, which calls the shared block renderer with PREVIEW_ROWS, while create_diff_summary calls it with usize::MAX to retain unbounded behavior.

The preview helper defines a 12-row preview and a 64-KiB source ceiling; visible_byte_count accounts for UTF-8 boundaries, character display width, tabs, wrapping, and zero-width content before expensive styling and allocation.

The shared renderer decrements one rendered-row budget across files, uses Paragraph wrapping to measure final row use, preserves per-file headers, stops content rendering after omission, and appends a notice directing the user to the transcript.

Add, delete, and update rendering now restricts highlighting and line construction to a visible source prefix and reports whether content was omitted; callers that pass usize::MAX retain full rendering.
PatchHistoryCell routes display_lines to create_diff_preview and transcript_lines to create_diff_summary, while raw_lines continues to derive plain lines from the full summary.
The minified-diff test asserts a 12-row inline prefix plus an omission/transcript hint and separately asserts that transcript and raw views equal the complete diff summary.
Parameterized tests verify bounded previews for add, delete, update, and rename cases and verify that transcript output remains complete.
A multi-file test verifies that the content budget is shared across files while all file summaries remain present and an omission notice is shown.
Width-sensitive tests verify exactly 12 rendered body rows at widths 8, 16, 40, and 80 for long ASCII, wide, tabbed, and combining-character inputs.
Small diffs and diffs exactly at the row budget remain identical to the complete summary, including empty and rename-only entries.
Zero-width combining-mark tests verify that scanning stops at the 64-KiB boundary, later file summaries remain visible, and transcript output remains complete for add, delete, and update forms.

The committed test suite supplies behavioral oracles for bounded rendered rows, bounded source scanning, omission signaling, preserved summaries, unchanged small diffs, and complete transcript/raw views; test execution status is not available in the evidence bundle.

candidate_atomics.name: bound-inline-diff-preview-work
candidate_atomics.title: Bound inline diff rendering by visible rows and scanned source
candidate_atomics.description: Apply a shared content budget before syntax highlighting and wrapped-row allocation, using both display-aware row accounting and a byte ceiling, while retaining summaries and explicitly signaling omitted content.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent an inline diff preview from doing work proportional to an arbitrarily large, minified, narrow-width, wide-character, or zero-width-heavy diff while still showing a useful prefix and review context.
semantic_action.pre_state: The inline surface renders complete change content through the same unbounded path as full review surfaces, allowing wrapping and highlighting work to scale with the entire input.
semantic_action.post_state: Inline content consumes at most the configured rendered-row budget across all files, source scanning cannot exceed the byte ceiling, unaffected summaries remain visible, and truncation is disclosed.
semantic_action.validation: Assert exact rendered-row limits across viewport widths and character classes; assert the source-byte boundary for zero-width input; assert summaries and omission guidance remain visible; assert small and exact-budget changes are unchanged.

candidate_atomics.name: separate-preview-and-full-review-contracts
candidate_atomics.title: Route compact and complete review surfaces through distinct rendering contracts
candidate_atomics.description: Use bounded rendering only for the inline display surface while preserving complete content in transcript and raw review surfaces.

semantic_action.intent: Reduce inline rendering cost without losing access to the complete diff needed for review, copying, or inspection.
semantic_action.pre_state: Inline display and complete review outputs share one full-summary renderer, so introducing a global limit would risk truncating every surface.
semantic_action.post_state: The inline display invokes the bounded preview contract, while transcript and raw outputs invoke the unbounded full-summary contract.
semantic_action.validation: For the same large change set, assert that inline output is limited and contains navigation guidance while transcript and raw outputs equal the complete summary.

candidate_workflows.name: introduce-bounded-diff-preview-with-full-review-fallback
candidate_workflows.title: Add a bounded inline diff preview without truncating complete review views
candidate_workflows.description: Establish a resource-bounded preview contract, implement display-aware early truncation and omission signaling, then route only the compact surface through it while validating both limits and full-content preservation.

workflow_graph.goal: Keep inline diff presentation responsive and predictably sized while preserving file-level context and complete diff access through dedicated review surfaces.
when_to_use: An inline or feed-style diff surface eagerly wraps, highlights, or allocates rows for complete change content.
Large, minified, narrow-width, wide-character, or zero-width-heavy changes can make preview cost or height effectively unbounded.
A separate transcript, raw, expanded, or detail surface can remain the source of complete content.
anti_goals: Do not impose the preview limit on transcript, raw, expanded, export, or other complete-review surfaces.
Do not remove file summaries or rename metadata merely because the content budget is exhausted.
Do not treat logical source lines alone as the visible budget when viewport wrapping can produce multiple rendered rows.
Do not rely only on display width to bound source scanning, because zero-width input can consume bytes without consuming columns.
Do not truncate small or exact-budget diffs.
not_applicable_when: The surface is itself the canonical complete diff view and no alternate full-content review path exists.
Rendering already performs bounded lazy or virtualized work with an equivalent visible-row and source-scan invariant.
The input is only a file summary and does not render change content.
inputs: A change-set representation covering additions, deletions, updates, and renames
The inline viewport width and wrapping behavior
The complete-view entry points for transcript, raw, expanded, or equivalent output
A user-visible omission message that identifies the complete review path
workflow_graph.entry_state: One unbounded rendering path supplies inline and complete-review surfaces, so expensive processing and any prospective truncation are not isolated by presentation role.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Inline rendering has bounded row allocation and bounded source scanning across the whole change set, retains summary/navigation context, and signals omissions; complete-review surfaces still expose the full diff.

steps.condition: Apply when the compact surface renders change content whose wrapped size or source size is not inherently bounded.
steps.validation: Verify shared 12-row behavior across files and widths, UTF-8-safe 64-KiB source limiting, omission signaling, retained summaries, and unchanged small/exact-budget output.

steps.condition: Apply when compact and complete review surfaces previously shared a renderer or output method.
steps.validation: Verify inline display uses the bounded renderer and that transcript and raw outputs still equal the unbounded complete summary for truncated cases.

validation_ladder: Confirm small and exact-budget diffs render identically to the full summary.
Confirm additions, deletions, updates, renames, and multiple files obey one shared rendered-row budget.
Confirm actual wrapped viewport rows remain bounded at narrow and normal widths for ASCII, tabs, wide characters, and combining sequences.
Confirm zero-width-heavy source scanning stops at the byte ceiling without hiding later file summaries.
Confirm an omission notice directs users to the complete review path.
Confirm transcript and raw outputs preserve the complete diff whenever the inline preview is truncated.
stop_conditions: Stop if no distinct complete-review surface can preserve omitted content and product requirements require the inline surface to be complete.
Stop if viewport wrapping or character-width behavior cannot be measured consistently enough to define a rendered-row oracle.
Stop and defer if truncation can hide mandatory metadata rather than content-only rows.
Stop if tests cannot distinguish bounded inline output from complete transcript/raw output.
